title: Award Winning Historic Home 6 mins Downtown/Bdway
description:
Winner of the 20 time SuperHost Golden Key Award! Beautiful historic house, friendly Southern charm and AMAZING location, just minutes drive to downtown & Broadway, the famous 5 points, Nissan Stadium, Vanderbilt, Gaylord Opry Resort & Opry Mills Mall. Walking distance to Folk restaurant, Red Headed Stranger Tacos, Audrey, Coneheads Chicken Shop, Retrograde coffee, & more. We provide tea, coffee, fresh linens, towels, shampoos, and all the necessities you will need to make your trip perfect :).

The space
Welcome to our spacious and stylish Airbnb nestled in the heart of East Nashville! This unique historic home exudes character and offers a cozy and comfortable stay for your visit. With three original fireplaces with tile dating back to the 1800s, you are stepping into one of East Nashville’s best kept historic secrets!

As you step inside, you'll be greeted by the inviting atmosphere and unique features of this well-preserved gem. The original architectural details, including beautiful original hardwood floors and moldings, showcase the rich history of the home. The fireplaces are non-functioning, but provide a unique and discerning backdrop for your group, with handmade tiles throughout each, and amazing detail and craftsmanship. Each fireplace adds a touch of warmth and elegance to the space, creating an ambiance that is both cozy and elegant.

The location of our Airbnb is truly unbeatable. Situated in East Nashville, you'll find yourself within walking distance to some vibrant and trendy restaurants. Folk, Red Headed Stranger, Audrey, Xiao Bao, The Wilburn Street Tavern, All People Coffee, and some other neighborhood gems are all within a 10 minute walk. Less than a 5 minute drive is the famous Five Points area, where there are vintage stores, restaurants, bars and art galleries. Downtown is just a 6 minute car ride. Whether you're craving a gourmet meal, casual dining, or local flavors, you'll have an array of options at your fingertips. Indulge in the local culinary scene and experience the diverse flavors that Nashville has to offer.

After a day of exploring East Nashville or Downtown with all the honky-tonks, you can retreat to the comfort of your home away from home. Relax in the spacious living area or gather around the dining table for a memorable meal. The dining table was handmade by a local Nashville fireman, and easily seats 8 people; 3 more can sit at the kitchen island. The fully equipped kitchen provides everything you need to whip up a delicious home-cooked meal or brew a cup of coffee to start your day; dishware, glasses, silverware, blenders, mixers, crockpots, baking sheets; this historic home is fully equipped to cook a holiday meal or family meal while surrounded by your loved ones.

When it's time to rest, you'll find peace and tranquility in the well-appointed bedrooms. Sink into plush bedding and enjoy a restful night's sleep, ready to take on another day of adventure in Nashville. Smart TVs are in all the bedrooms, and there is high speed internet throughout the house. Each of the bedrooms are equipped with sound machines for a restful night, and there are hairdryers and mirrors in each room.

The bathrooms are clean, modern, and stocked with fresh towels and complimentary toiletries, making it easy for everyone to get ready in the morning or wind down at night. Both bathrooms have large jetted tubs, perfect to unwind and relax on your trip.

Outside, you'll find a spacious and fully fenced private backyard with a gas grill and comfortable seating, perfect for enjoying the beautiful Nashville weather. Whether it's a morning cup of coffee on the front deck with a true Southern wraparound porch, or grilling with family & friends in the backyard, these outdoor spaces will surely enhance your stay.

We provide a guidebook of places we personally recommend for all our guests, so whether you're visiting for business or pleasure, our Airbnb in East Nashville promises a delightful stay. Immerse yourself in the history and culture of Nashville, while enjoying the convenience of nearby restaurants and amenities. Book your stay with us today and make lasting memories in this one-of-a-kind historic home.

Guest access
Guests have access to the whole house; fully stocked chef's kitchen to cook, fenced in private backyard to grill, a Southern wraparound front porch with swing to while away the hours or just enjoy their coffee in the morning before they head out and see all Nashville has to offer. There are 3 parking spots in a row/front-to-back in the front yard, and lots of free street parking available also.

Other things to note
Please note, the fireplaces are non-functioning. Two bedrooms and both bathrooms are located on the first floor. The 3rd bedroom is the only room located upstairs (it is the room pictured with two queen beds). 
Permit number is located with the photos of the property.

host_details:
I'm from Ireland originally, and moved to America about 12 years ago.. I lived in New York for a number of years, and then made the move to Nashville. After spending some time in the East Nashville area, I fell in love with Nashville. I spent time between Nashville and NY over the years, and have traveled pretty extensively around the world since leaving Ireland in my early 20s, so I have stayed in A LOT of hostels, hotels, regular B&Bs and Airbnbs, and always had a passion for learning as I traveled. 
I grew up in a B&B (that my parents owned) in Dublin, Ireland in the 80s waaaay before everyone was online, so Colin always says hosting is in my blood, and he's right - I love it, and want to continue to do it as long as we possibly can. He has joined in on my passion for it, and we do it together now. We currently do it professionally, and have been honored to receive an award from Airbnb for being Superhosts 20 times in a row, which was no easy feat :). We love to host, and love to help create a memorable experience for our guests. Come stay with us, and see what it's all about. :)
Where I went to school: Dublin, Ireland
I'm obsessed with: My kids, love, life!
